column1: # The inputs of each model check in CI: a full run over the same inputs gives the same verdict, so CI remembers a pass
# by a hash of them (verification/model-keys.sh, the `changes` job in .github/workflows/ci.yml) and re-runs the full
# rows only when the hash has no pass yet. Every run.sh reads only its inputs (kernel/tests/kith-model-keys-check).
# A model's drift.sh is never an input: a SYNC bump changes no verdict.
